summary.en: Multi-enzyme DIA and collision-energy-resolved spectral libraries expand complementary peptide and metabolite evidence.
summary.zh: 多酶切DIA与碰撞能量分辨谱库扩展肽及代谢物鉴定的互补证据。

en: Today's papers explore complementary evidence in proteomics and small-molecule identification, from multiplexed enzyme digests to precursor-specific collision-energy profiles.
Coverage is limited by access to some publisher pages; these selections do not represent an exhaustive survey.
zh: 今天关注蛋白组与小分子鉴定中的互补证据：从多酶切整合到不同前体的碰撞能量曲线。
部分出版商页面访问受限，本次精选不代表穷尽检索。

papers.title: Multi-Enzyme Data-Independent Acquisition Mass Spectrometry for Proteoform-Aware Single-shot Proteomics

read_scope.en: Primary indexed abstract and metadata; not full text or independently reproduced.
read_scope.zh: 原始索引摘要与元数据；未读全文，未复现。

commentary.zh: mE-DIA合并互补酶切为单次DIA，结合无谱库分析、proteoform推断与交互肽图；同原始数据及搜索空间比较DDA谱库型流程，蛋白组增加30%，CV≤20%定量组增加47%。增益依赖比较条件，骨架变体推断不等于完整proteoform实证。
commentary.en: mE-DIA multiplexes complementary enzyme digests into one DIA injection, integrating library-free analysis with proteoform inference and an interactive peptide mapper. On the same raw data and within a shared search space, the authors report 30% more identified protein groups and 47% more groups quantified at CV ≤20% than their DDA-library-based multi-enzyme DIA comparator. Gains are comparison-specific; inferred backbone variants are not experimentally established complete proteoforms.

papers.title: Three-dimensional mass spectral libraries for improved metabolites identification using collision energy profiles of protonated and radical cation precursors

read_scope.en: Indexed publisher abstract and selected text; not full methods or independently reproduced.
read_scope.zh: 官方索引摘要及部分正文；未读完整方法，未复现。

commentary.zh: 碰撞能量曲线增补谱库维度，利用两类前体互补碎裂；40种化合物最强10种元素式损失中79%不同，9种血浆加标物演示SWATH匹配。样本规模小，软件需适配。
commentary.en: Collision-energy profiles add a third dimension to spectral libraries, exploiting complementary fragmentation of radical cations and protonated precursors. Across 40 compounds, 79% of the ten most abundant formula losses differed between precursor types; SWATH profile matching was demonstrated with nine substances spiked into plasma. Validation remains small-scale and search software needs adaptation.
